sources.search_query: official United Kingdom electronic travel authorisation ETA gov.uk apply
sources.relevant_excerpt: An electronic travel authorisation (ETA) lets you travel to the UK, Jersey, Guernsey or the Isle of Man for up to 6 months. ... You usually need an ETA rather than a visa if you're from Europe, the USA, Australia, Canada or certain other countries. ... Each person travelling needs an ETA, including babies and children. ... An ETA does not guarantee entry to the UK, Jersey, Guernsey or the Isle of Man.

sources.search_query: official United Kingdom electronic travel authorisation ETA gov.uk apply
sources.relevant_excerpt: It costs £20 to apply online or through the UK ETA app. You cannot get a refund after you apply. ... An ETA lasts for 2 years or until your passport expires, whichever is sooner. ... You can travel to the UK as many times as you want while you have an ETA. ... [A decision comes] usually within a day [but allow] up to 3 working days. ... [The ETA] will be linked to the passport you applied with.

sources.search_query: United Kingdom Standard Visitor visa fee gov.uk
sources.relevant_excerpt: A Standard Visitor visa costs £135 for up to 6 months. ... You can usually stay in the UK for up to 6 months. ... Depending on your nationality, you'll either: have to apply for a Standard Visitor visa before you travel to the UK [or apply for] an electronic travel authorisation (ETA) [or] be able to visit the UK for up to 6 months without needing a visa or an ETA. ... You must have a passport or travel document to enter the UK. It should be valid for the whole of your stay. ... The earliest you can apply is 3 months before you travel.

sources.search_query: United Kingdom Standard Visitor visa fee gov.uk
sources.relevant_excerpt: Fees: Standard Visitor visa £135 (up to 6 months); visiting for medical reasons £234 (11 months); academic £234 (12 months); long-term Standard Visitor visa: 2 years £506, 5 years £903, 10 years £1,128 — each allowing stays of up to 6 months per visit. ... You must apply online before you travel to the UK. ... The earliest you can apply is 3 months before you travel. ... [At a visa application centre appointment you must] have your fingerprints and a photo (biometric information) taken. ... You'll usually get a decision on your visa within 3 weeks. ... If you're applying with family members, each person must have their own application and pay the fee.

sources.search_query: none — direct fetch of known official GOV.UK immigration rules URL
sources.relevant_excerpt: Immigration Rules Appendix Visitor: Visa national list, VN 1.1.(a): alphabetical list of 115 countries/territories whose nationals or citizens need a visit visa (entry clearance) before travelling to the UK, running from Afghanistan through Zimbabwe. The list includes "People's Republic of China*", India, Russia, Turkey and "Taiwan*" (asterisked entries subject to exceptions in VN 2.2). VN 2.2 exceptions: nationals of China holding a Hong Kong SAR or Macao SAR passport, and nationals of Taiwan holding a passport which includes the number of the identification card issued by the competent authority in Taiwan, do not need a visit visa. Additional exemptions apply to school groups from France (ages 18 and under) and Germany (ages 19 and under), and time-limited transitional provision for certain Nicaraguan and St Lucian ETA holders (until 5 March 2026).
sources.effective_date_evidence: Transitional provision for Nicaragua/St Lucia ETA holders expires 5 March 2026

policies.description: Digital permission to travel (not a visa) required by non-visa nationals visiting the UK, Jersey, Guernsey or the Isle of Man for up to 6 months, or transiting through UK border control. Costs £20, valid 2 years or until passport expiry, unlimited entries, linked to one passport. Apply via the UK ETA app or online at GOV.UK.
conditions: TWN eligible only with a Taiwan passport that includes the personal identification card number

policies.policy_name: Standard Visitor visa / Appendix Visitor: Visa national list
policies.description: Nationals of the 115 countries/territories on the Immigration Rules Appendix Visitor: Visa national list (including China, India, Russia, Turkey) must obtain a Standard Visitor visa (entry clearance) before travelling to the UK for tourism. Application is online via GOV.UK followed by biometric enrolment at an overseas visa application centre (operated by VFS Global). £135 for up to 6 months; long-term options 2/5/10 years.
conditions: Exceptions (VN 2.2): Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR passport holders, and Taiwan passports containing the national ID card number, are not visa nationals
